data.name: Let local Codex understand and invoke capabilities from every Quantum plugin.
data.value: 让本机 Codex 理解并调用 Quantum 中的插件能力。

data.name: The plugin starts codex app-server and reuses your existing local sign-in.
data.value: 插件会启动 codex app-server，并复用本机已有登录状态。

data.name: Open Codex on its full page
Ask Codex to inspect your calendar, create a task, or use RPCs published by other plugins.
data.value: 你可以让 Codex 查询日历、创建待办，或调用其他插件公开的 RPC。

data.name: Automatically connects to local Codex. Connection errors appear here; you can retry.
data.value: 自动连接本机 Codex；连接失败会显示原因，可手动重试。

data.name: Automatic connection timed out. Check the local Codex installation and sign-in, then retry.
data.value: 自动连接超时。请检查本机 Codex 安装和登录状态后重试。

data.name: The installed Codex CLI is too old for the selected model. Run `npm install -g @openai/codex@latest`, then disconnect and reconnect.
data.value: 当前 Codex CLI 版本过旧，无法使用所选模型。请运行 `npm install -g @openai/codex@latest`，然后断开并重新连接。

data.name: The Codex app-server connection closed.
data.value: Codex App Server 连接已关闭。

data.name: The Codex app-server process could not be started.
data.value: 无法启动 Codex App Server 进程。

data.name: Codex did not return a thread id.
Could not register a Codex request.
data.value: 无法注册 Codex 请求。

data.name: Wait for the current Codex turn to finish.
data.value: 请等待当前 Codex 轮次结束。

data.name: No Codex conversation is active.
data.value: 当前没有活动的 Codex 会话。

data.name: The RPC catalog contains a method without a name.
data.value: RPC 目录中存在未命名的方法。

data.name: Internal server error
data.value: 服务器内部错误，请稍后重试。

data.name: A turn is running. Progress updates automatically.
data.value: 正在执行，进度将自动更新。

data.name: Connect Codex and choose its working directory on the desktop first. Opening this page never starts a process.
data.value: 请先在电脑连接 Codex 并选择工作目录；打开此页不会启动进程。

data.name: Sending starts a model turn and may consume usage or run Quantum tools on the desktop.
data.value: 发送会启动模型任务，可能消耗用量并在电脑上调用 Quantum 工具。

data.name: Unable to load data. Reconnecting automatically.
data.value: 暂时无法加载数据，正在自动重连。

data.name: Showing the latest 10 messages, with long messages shortened. Open the desktop for full history.
data.value: 仅展示最近 10 条消息，较长内容会截断，完整历史请在电脑查看。

data.name: Could not add attachment. Use up to four files, 8 MiB each and 16 MiB total.
data.value: 无法添加附件。最多 4 个文件，每个不超过 8 MiB，总计不超过 16 MiB。

data.name: Recording unavailable. Check microphone permission.
data.value: 无法录音，请检查麦克风权限。

data.name: Voice transcription or attachment processing failed. Check the selected model and try again.
data.value: 语音识别或附件处理失败，请检查当前模型后重试。

data.name: A prompt or attachment is required.
data.value: 请输入消息或添加附件。

data.name: Invalid attachment metadata or size.
data.value: 附件信息或大小无效，请重新选择。

data.name: Invalid attachment encoding.
data.value: 附件数据无效，请重新选择。

data.name: Use PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images.
data.value: 请选择 PNG、JPEG、GIF 或 WebP 格式的图片。

data.name: Install a speech.transcribe provider for this desktop platform.
data.value: 请为当前桌面平台安装语音识别服务。

data.name: The requested speech language is not installed on this desktop.
data.value: 此电脑尚未安装当前语言的语音识别。

data.name: No speech was recognized. Try recording again.
data.value: 未识别到语音，请重新录制。

data.name: Use the voice recorder or select a PCM WAV recording.
data.value: 请使用录音按钮，或选择 PCM WAV 录音。
